crash.prompt: MatchFrame closed unexpectedly. Send a crash report?
crash.detail: A report holds the support file (settings without passwords or tokens, health and recent logs) and what crashed. You can change this any time in Settings → General → Program.
crash.sentBody: ID {id}. Quote it to MatchFrame support.

engine.remoteHuds: Desktop HUDs run on the production computer.
engine.starting: The MatchFrame engine is still starting. Try again in a moment.
engine.unreachable: Cannot reach the MatchFrame engine on this computer: {error}
engine.remoteReason: Desktop HUDs are unavailable in remote mode: the HUD belongs over the game on the production computer
engine.launchRemote: CS2 starts on the production computer: use Start CS2 there.

connect.title: Connection settings
connect.intro: Choose where the MatchFrame engine runs. HUD outputs, the director and camera control always run on the production computer.
connect.localBody: MatchFrame runs its engine here (single-PC setups, or the production PC in a multi-PC setup).
connect.remoteBody: Use this computer as an extra operator position for the MatchFrame engine on another computer.
connect.tokenPlaceholder: Issued on the production computer: Devices & Integrations → Tokens
connect.tokenNote: Use a role token (for example observer or producer), not the production computer's owner token. On the production computer, MatchFrame must listen on its network address (MATCHFRAME_HOST) and the firewall must allow it.
connect.onlyInProgram: This page only works inside the MatchFrame program.
connect.startingLocal: Starting the engine on this computer…
connect.invalidAddress: That is not a valid address (example: 192.168.1.20 or http://192.168.1.20:37211).
connect.needToken: Enter the access token issued on the production computer (Devices & Integrations → Tokens).
connect.tokenRefused: The production computer did not accept this token (expired, revoked or for another installation).
connect.captainToken: That is a captain veto token; use an operator role token.
connect.unreachable: Cannot reach {origin}: {error}. Check that MatchFrame runs there with MATCHFRAME_HOST set to its network address, and the firewall allows port {port}.

launch.hlaeNotChosen: HLAE.exe is not chosen yet (download HLAE from advancedfx.org).
launch.hlaeWrongFile: Choose the HLAE.exe file from the HLAE folder.
launch.hlaeMoved: HLAE.exe is no longer at {path}. Choose it again.
launch.hlaeNoHook: This HLAE has no CS2 hook (x64\AfxHookSource2.dll). Install the latest HLAE.
launch.gsiNote: The game data (GSI) config could not be written: {error}
launch.restartForGsi: CS2 is already running. Restart it so it reads the new game data (GSI) config.
launch.closeFirst: CS2 is already running without MatchFrame's launch options. Close CS2, then click Start CS2 again.
launch.cs2Missing: cs2.exe was not found at {path}. Check the CS2 folder in Settings → Setup.
launch.startSteam: Start Steam first: HLAE starts cs2.exe directly and needs Steam running.
launch.hlaeFailed: HLAE could not start CS2 (exit code {code}). After a CS2 update HLAE often needs an update too: install the latest HLAE and try again.
launch.hlaeStarting: Starting CS2 with HLAE (insecure). MatchFrame connects to its console on port {port} when it is up.
launch.steamStartingTools: Starting CS2 through Steam with the console on port {port} (needs the CS2 Workshop Tools).

rollback.fresh: There's no MatchFrame data on this computer yet, so there's nothing to restore.
rollback.keep: This version reads your data as it is: nothing is restored and nothing is lost.
rollback.restore: Restores the copy of your data made {when}. Changes made since then (teams, players, matches, HUD and other settings) are lost; today's data is kept as a copy in the backups folder.
rollback.restoreFrom: Restores the copy of your data made {when}, when version {version} was updated. Changes made since then (teams, players, matches, HUD and other settings) are lost; today's data is kept as a copy in the backups folder.
rollback.toStable: {target} is the latest Stable version. It's older than the beta you have ({current}).
rollback.verified: The installer for {target} has been downloaded and matches the release's SHA256SUMS.txt.
rollback.stays: Your HUD files and program settings stay. Automatic update downloads are turned off, so MatchFrame doesn't update straight back; turn them on again in Settings → General → Program.
rollback.closes: MatchFrame and every HUD output close now; version {target} starts when it's installed.
rollback.title: Go back to a previous version
rollback.busy: MatchFrame is already going back to a version.
rollback.notInstallable: Version {version} can't be installed from here (it isn't an earlier Stable release with an installer and checksums).
rollback.dataChanged: Your data changed while the installer was downloading. Nothing was changed; try again.
rollback.installing: Installing version {version}. MatchFrame closes and starts again when it's done.
rollback.listFormat: GitHub's list of releases is not in the expected form.
rollback.noGithub: Can't reach GitHub for the list of versions: {error}
rollback.rateLimited: GitHub is limiting requests from this network for now. Try again in an hour.
rollback.githubHttp: GitHub answered HTTP {status} for the list of versions.
rollback.downloadFailed: Couldn't download the installer for version {version} (HTTP {status}).
rollback.checksumMismatch: The downloaded installer for version {version} doesn't match its SHA-256 in {file} (expected {expected}, got {actual}). It was deleted; nothing was changed.

updates.turnedOff: Updates are turned off on this computer (MATCHFRAME_DISABLE_UPDATES).

hud.managerOnly: Desktop HUDs are only available in the MatchFrame manager window.
hud.productionOnly: {what} is only possible on the production computer, where the HUDs are installed.
hud.zipTooLarge: The ZIP file is larger than {mb} MB.
hud.notInstalled: No HUD with the id {id} is installed.
hud.builtIn: {name} is part of the program and has no folder.
hud.folderMissing: {name}'s folder is missing. Reinstall the HUD.
hud.folderOutside: {name}'s folder is outside the HUD library folder and is not opened.
hud.badAddress: The HUD server returned an unexpected address.
hud.didNotLoad: The HUD did not load ({reason}). Retrying…
hud.keepsStopping: The HUD keeps stopping ({reason}). Close it and launch it again.
hud.locked: {name}'s position is locked. Unlock it to move it.
hud.libraryUnavailable: The HUD library is not available: {error}
hud.notOpen: That HUD is not open on the desktop. Launch it first.

hotkeys.mustDiffer: The toggle and emergency hide hotkeys must be different.
hotkeys.reserved: The {name} hotkey {key} is already one of the program's own hotkeys (emergency stop, save the CS2 view).
hotkeys.hudToggleName: show or hide the desktop HUDs
hotkeys.sameKey: {a} and {b} can't have the same key ({key}).
hotkeys.ownKey: {key} is already the program's {name} hotkey: choose another key for {action}.
hotkeys.badKey: {key} isn't a key Windows can use as a hotkey ({error}).
hotkeys.taken: {key} is already taken by another program (or Windows): choose another key for {action}.
